name: analyze_user_selection
description: Determine which of the numbered profile options the user picked, and whether they instead asked to register a new profile. Used only when rule-based matching on numbers, emails and roles was inconclusive.

selected_option.description: The option number the user chose. Must be one of the numbers listed in the available options. Null when the message does not identify any single option.

confidence.description: Confidence in selected_option, from 0.0 to 1.0. Use 0.0 when selected_option is null.

reasoning.description: One short sentence explaining which part of the user's message identified the option

alternative_matches.description: Other option numbers the message could plausibly refer to, best first. Empty when the choice is unambiguous.

requires_clarification.description: True when the user should be asked again because no option matched or several matched equally well

register.description: Set when the user asked to register a new profile rather than pick an existing one

type.description: The role the user asked to register as, or null when they did not ask to register
